row.notes: TRACK_DATA record store (vector {allocator, begin, end, cap} of 16-byte {allocator, TrackDataRecord*} at TrackDataSystem+0x20), index = the record's statId byte (record+1). While the vector is shorter than statId it appends zeroed {0,0} entries (holes); at size == statId it allocates 0xd08, copy-constructs 0x142ee6710 and appends (returns -1); otherwise returns 0 when items[statId] already holds a record, else stores the new record there. Ids are u8, so the vector never exceeds 256; holes are null entries (R8).

Both callers pass TrackDataSystem+0x20 (0x142e5b8e5 lea rcx,[rdi+0x20] before 0x142e4c640 -> 0x142e55dfb; 0x142e60cbb add rsi,0x20 before 0x142e60ce6). Correction: the append path does not return -1. It sets rax = -1, shl rax,4, mov rax,[rbp+rax+8] (0x142e57aa4..0x142e57aaf), i.e. returns the record pointer of the last item; so the function returns the stored TrackDataRecord* on success and 0 only when the slot is occupied (0x142e60850 returns that value: 0x142e60ceb mov rsi,rax ... mov rax,rsi).
